# volcano_storage_objects (Data Source)

List storage objects across all of a project's buckets, optionally filtered.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "volcano_storage_objects" "logos" {
  project_id = volcano_project.example.id
  search     = "logo"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `owner_id` (String) Filter by owning auth user ID.
- `search` (String) Case-insensitive substring match on object name.

### Read-Only

- `objects` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--objects))

<a id="nestedatt--objects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `objects`

Read-Only:

- `bucket_name` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `is_public` (Boolean)
- `mime_type` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `owner_id` (String)
- `public_url` (String)
- `size` (Number)
- `updated_at` (String)
